summary: Phase 6 (NF characterization, keystone sorry at StaviCompleteness.lean:1567) is blocked on missing infrastructure: the GHR93 Proposition 7 composition lemma for EF games. Six proof approaches were analyzed in depth. All require this composition lemma, which composes Duplicator winning strategies on sub-intervals into a strategy on the full interval. Without it, the inductive step of nf_characterizable_by_stavi cannot connect the IH (1-variable depth-k NFs have characteristic StaviFormulas) to the goal (1-variable depth-(k+1) NFs have characteristic StaviFormulas), because the quantifier part involves 2-variable NFs whose joint type is not determined by individual 1-variable types. Phases 7 (no_gaps_discrete) and 8 (succ_cofinal) depend on Phase 6 via the chain: nf_characterizable -> stavi_expressive_completeness -> no_gaps_discrete -> one_class -> succ_cofinal. No code changes were made; build passes (1667 jobs, zero errors).
blocking_issues: GHR93 Proposition 7 (composition lemma for custom EF games) not formalized in codebase
No existing infrastructure to compose Duplicator winning strategies on sub-intervals
1-variable IH cannot determine 2-variable quantifier types without composition
All six analyzed approaches require this missing lemma or its equivalent
continuation_context: The sorry at StaviCompleteness.lean:1567 is the keystone blocking Phases 6-9. Three options exist: (A) Implement GHR93 Proposition 7 (~200-300 lines) as a new lemma, then build the inductive step using it. (B) Direct construction of temporal formulas for each 2-variable sub_nf using game infrastructure (~300-500 lines). (C) Research an alternative non-game-theoretic proof. Option A is recommended as the cleanest path. The existing game infrastructure (ghr93_duplicator_wins, game_tuple, ghr93_winning_condition) provides the foundation. The composition lemma would take two winning strategies on [x,c] and [c,y] and produce one on [x,y]. See handoff file for full technical details and existing infrastructure inventory.
